notes.title: Nikola Tesla: War of the Currents
notes.content: Can you outsmart Thomas Edison and electrify the world? [i]"Nikola Tesla: War of the Currents"[/i] is an interactive science-fiction novel by Dora Klindžić where you will fend off Edison’s spies, Wall Street bankers, electrical industry magnates and other unsavory types as you navigate real historical adventures involving electrocuted elephants and the Niagara Falls electric plant.
